body:
This was my first experience with catnip, and I have used several other legal herbs and such. I found some wild catnip and picked it, and then dried it. Some of my friends have had positive experiences with it, so I decided to check it out. I smoked three bowls in a period of about five minutes, and settled down in my volkswagen Vanagon, which I was camping in. I decided to read 1984, the book I was in the middle of. Immediatly I felt slight joy, more of an excited happiness. I really grokked the message, forever changing my view of government, reality, and thought. This was the deepest experience I have ever had with a book. The joy slowly faded to a more content happyness, with calmness. I kept reading, and the feeling continued for another few hours until I fell asleep.
